hook: Telangana sets money aside for *backup drinking water* before El Nino.
hook_b: Telangana sets money aside for *backup drinking water* before El Nino.
tldr: Minister Seethakka announced funds for alternative drinking water facilities in view of El Nino.

beats.what: The Hans India reports Minister Seethakka announced funds for alternative drinking water facilities amid El Nino.
beats.why: El Nino years usually bring weaker monsoon and tighter water; the state is planning a backup.
beats.care: Water supply is the first thing to strain in summer. Know your area's backup before March.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Hans India headline: funds announced for alternative drinking water facility amid El Nino. Amount and districts were not in the headline.

cards.q: El Nino may tighten water. What should the state do first?
opts: Water price slabs for heavy users
